## Required Target Verification

Before staging validation, the technical owner and IT operator must provide the staging URL and access, supported runtime, database and storage details, repeatable deployment and rollback steps, HTTPS, backups and restore evidence, monitoring and incident ownership, and email or queue operations evidence. These are not required to implement the bounded local UI correction, but they prevent this run from claiming staging or production acceptance.

## Gate Decision

Design passes for the bounded local implementation because the existing runtime, client stack, UI primitive, server contract, and synthetic test data path are available. Design remains blocked for target-environment validation under DEP-10 (Gate 1 environment and ownership evidence for credible staging and production planning). The requester authorized continuation of this local issue cycle; that authorization does not authorize staging deployment or production change.
